FO-002.name: context-indexed relation
FO-002.signature: Rel_C : TYPE_PROJECTION_C x TYPE_PROJECTION_C x TYPE_WITNESS_C -> Prop
FO-002.admissibility: Defined only on well-typed projections and valid relation witnesses

FO-003.name: context-indexed distinction
FO-003.relation_to_Eval_D: Distinct inputs must have defined Eval_D evaluations exceeding epsilon_a,C threshold

FO-004.name: representable distinction judgment
FO-004.signature: RepDist_C : TYPE_PROJECTION_C x TYPE_PROJECTION_C x TYPE_WITNESS_C -> Prop
FO-004.truth_conditions: RepDist_C(p, q, w) iff type(p) = TYPE_PROJECTION_C ∧ type(q) = TYPE_PROJECTION_C ∧ TypedWitness_C(w) ∧ Rel_C(p, q, w) ∧ TraceCompatible_C(w)

FO-005.name: typed semantic relation witness
FO-005.witness_target: Validates relation witness w in context C, independent of concrete realization

FO-008.name: witness transport across transition
FO-008.signature: Transport_C : TYPE_TRANSITION x TYPE_WITNESS_C x TYPE_WITNESS_C -> Prop
FO-008.partiality: Partial (not guaranteed to be total for all typed transitions)
